newsitem.title: USA: Kinetiks.com to be dislited from Nasdaq.
newsitem.headline: Kinetiks.com to be dislited from Nasdaq.

text.p: Kinetiks.com Inc said on Monday its common stock would be removed from trading on the Nasdaq Small Cap Market from October 28 because it has not maintained the required minimum levels of $2 million in total assets and $1 million in capital and surplus.
The company said it is in talks with potential strategic partners and financial investors for additional financing in the near- to mid-term.

It also said it has begun a restructuring plan to reduce monthly expenses to more closely match the projected monthly cash flow generated by collection of current amounts due on existing contracts, scheduled payments due upon reduction of existing backlog, and projection of cash flow from potential new contracts.

If it succeeds in obtaining additional short-term financing, the company said, it believes it can implement the restructuring without "material impairment" of production capabilities or levels of customer support or sales.
However, there is no guarantee that it can get such financing or meet projected cash flow, it said.
It said it has entered into an asset-based financing arrangement of up to $200,000 with a Houston-based merchant bank and is exploring a broader relationship with that firm.
Kinetiks.com added that it has cancelled the sale of its capital stock as it believes that a successful closing of that placement would not be completed in the near term.
